notes: Fresh account+key. ZIP -> 202 {batch_id,status,status_url:/api/v1/batch/{ulid}}; items extracted and worker-processed (2/2 completed). No input -> 400 BATCH_INPUT_REQUIRED; file+direct_upload_id -> 400 BATCH_INPUT_CONFLICT; webhook_secret never echoed in create/progress/list responses.
s3_bucket+s3_prefix -> 501 S3_INPUT_UNSUPPORTED with doc_url; manifest_url alone -> same 501. No Batch row created (DB and list show only legit batches).

job_type=weird -> 422 INVALID_JOB_TYPE naming ['cost','dfm']. Cost manifest with quantities='abc' -> 400 INVALID_COST_MANIFEST "Row 2: invalid quantity 'abc'". job_type=cost (BATCH_COST_ENABLED default on) -> 202, completed, cost CSV columns produced. 501 flag-off path not exercisable without env change (notes-only).

Non-ZIP bytes named .zip -> 400 BAD_REQUEST 'File is not a zip file', no orphaned batch. 9.9MB manifest -> 413 BATCH_MANIFEST_TOO_LARGE (2MiB cap) live. concurrency_limit=99 -> 422 INVALID_BATCH_CONCURRENCY {min:1,max:12}. webhook_url=169.254.169.254 -> 400 webhook_url_rejected (SSRF). 5GiB declared/streamed ZIP 413 code-verified only (batch_router.py:234-256; multipart parse precedes the endpoint check so a spoofed Content-Length without a real multi-GiB body cannot reach it).

Environment-bound (S3): GET /api/v1/uploads/capabilities -> available:false, unavailable_code:DIRECT_UPLOAD_REQUIRES_S3 (honest). Unknown direct_upload_id -> clean 404 DIRECT_UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND. Attach/idempotent-recovery/503 BATCH_ENQUEUE_FAILED paths need S3 + queue outage.
Newest-first with per-batch completed/failed/skipped counts, next_cursor + has_more (cursor observed); limit=500 -> 422; other-org key sees empty list (no leak).

Progress returns durable counters (total/completed/failed/skipped/pending + created/started/completed_at). Other-org and unknown batch -> 404 (never 403), same for /items. Items carry filename/status/analysis_id+url/verdict/best_process/issue_count/error_message/duration_ms; status=failed filter, cursor and limit<=200 (422 at 500) verified.

In-flight batch -> 400 'Batch not yet completed (status: pending)'. Completed DFM batch -> 200 text/csv Content-Disposition attachment filename=batch_{id}_results.csv; completed cost batch CSV has cost columns (make_now_process, crossover_qty, unit_cost_usd, cost_decision_url). Other-org -> 404.

Cancel pending batch -> 200 {batch_id,status:cancelled}; completed_at stamped, 2 items terminalized to skipped, pending 0. Re-cancel -> 409 'already in terminal state: cancelled'; cancel completed -> 409; other-org -> 404.

Unauthenticated list -> 200 total:2 with labeled/unlabeled counts, per-part metadata, process_family_guess, resolved label overlay and mesh_url; unlabeled_only filter works. Detail returns manifest record + full labels[] history; unknown part_id -> 404.
mesh.stl -> 200 content-type model/stl with ETag (part sha) and Cache-Control public,max-age=3600. Traversal ..%2F..%2F..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd -> 404; unknown 64-hex part -> 404.

Label '3d_printed' -> 422 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the 6-key ontology; unknown part_id -> 404. Success -> 200 {ok,part_id,label,labeler,ts}; labeler resolved from X-Labeler header and from body (body wins). Append-only verified in data/labels.jsonl (prior lines intact); latest label wins in overlay (sheet_metal then subtractive -> resolved subtractive).

Progress -> total_parts:2, labeled/unlabeled, per_label_counts zero-filled across all 6 keys, per_guess_counts, sorted labeler list; ?labeler= scopes resolution to that labeler's records (labeled count changed accordingly).
List 200 org-scoped with (project, current revision) serialization; other-org key -> 404 on my design; unknown design -> 404. 120/hour limit not deliberately exhausted per harness rules.

Valid plate plan -> 202 {design, job_id, poll_url}; generation completed in ~1s with geometry_hash + bbox. Extra body field -> 422 extra_forbidden; schema-invalid plan -> 422 VALIDATION_ERROR. 403 no-org path untestable (signup auto-creates org); 503 DESIGN_ENQUEUE_FAILED needs queue outage (notes-only).
'60x40 mm plate 5mm thick with two 6mm holes' -> 200 needs_input kind=plate with prefill dims and missing hole_diameter_mm; no DB write. Empty prompt -> 422; 600-char prompt -> 422.

Revision create -> 202 with job_id; immediate second POST -> 409 'The current revision is still generating'. Revision list -> current_revision 2 with both revisions ready. revisions/0 and /99 -> 404; other-org revision create -> 404.
Archive while revision generating -> 409 'A generating design cannot be archived'; after ready -> 204; unknown and other-org design -> 404.

preview.stl -> 200 model/stl inline filename sanitized ('Zfinal_Plate_2.stl', ~1MB). download.step -> 200 model/step attachment, Cache-Control: private, no-store, X-Geometry-SHA256 exactly equal to the revision geometry_hash, ISO-10303-21 body. revisions/1 and /2 variants 200. Download while new revision generating -> 409 'Design artifact is not ready'; other-org and unknown -> 404. 410 deleted-blob path not exercisable (no blob-deletion route).
Catalog: 3 offline_csv connectors (configured:true) + sandbox_api connectors (configured:false, live_credentials_required:true) with id/mode/boundary_label/metadata; no org data.

POST api_key secret with header_name -> 201; raw secret never echoed, only secret_fingerprint (hmac_sha256). api_key without header_name/query_param -> 400 clean domain error; unknown connector_id -> 404; string secret -> 422. GET list with connector_id filter -> 200.

Detail 200 own org; other-org key -> 404. Probe -> 200 {read_only:true, mode:sandbox_api, fingerprint, reason:null}, no live write. DELETE -> 200 serialized profile with revoked_at set and configured:false.

ground_truth_csv dry_run -> run status passed, rows_valid:1, imported_count:0, raw_stored:false, file sha256+size recorded. mode=import -> imported_count:1. mode=yolo -> 400; unknown connector -> 404; empty file -> 400; non-UTF-8 -> 400; 10.8MB CSV -> 413 (10MB cap exercised live).
List with connector_id filter + limit -> 200; status=bogus -> 400 'invalid integration run status'; detail 200 own org; other-org run -> 404; unknown run -> 404.

Created from saved cost decision (POST /validate/cost qa-box.stl -> saved.id) -> 201 package with items, honest warnings (decision_unapproved, confidence_unvalidated), raw_cad_included:false, live_supplier_send:false. Empty decision_ids -> 400; unknown decision -> 404; other-org decision -> 404.
List 200 org-scoped; detail includes 1 item; other-org and unknown package -> 404 'RFQ package not found.'

download.zip -> 200 application/zip, attachment 'Zfinal_RFQ_Package-{ulid}.zip' (sanitized). Valid ZIP: package_manifest.json, line-items.csv, supplier-brief.md/pdf, cost-decisions.json, per-decision evidence + raw-cad-unavailable.txt. Other-org -> 404.

Documented honest-disabled state: 200 {available:false, can_submit:true (analyst), effective_backend:none, customer_data_egress:false, requires_egress_acknowledgement:false}, honest message, accuracy_notice (estimate, not authoritative CAD), verify_path fallback.

Documented honest default: valid PNG + ULID Idempotency-Key -> 501 RECONSTRUCTION_UNAVAILABLE naming no-local-model and explicit remote-egress opt-in flags (never silent egress). 428/400/409/503/202 arms need an enabled backend (environment-bound, noted).

Malformed ULID, short garbage id, and well-formed unknown ULID all -> 404 'Mesh not found or job not complete'. Success/ownership-positive path untestable (no reconstruction backend in this deployment).

cost=-2 -> 422; empty part_id -> 422; domain-invalid evidence_sha256='nothex' passing schema -> 400 'must be a 64-character hex digest'. Create 200 org-stamped. source_type=synthetic forces stand_in:true with source rewritten '[STAND-IN — not real]' even when stand_in:false sent. Last-write-wins dedup on (part_id,process,quantity,shop): new id returned, old id 404s, cost updated 5.5->7.5. Reads org-scoped; other-org detail -> 404.

422 honest refusal: '2 REAL ground-truth record(s) (< 8 required)' with detail {n_real:2, n_records:3, min_real:8} and explicit copy that stand-in/synthetic never count. EXPECTED honest gate; single call kept within the 10/hour limit.

Template -> 200 text/plain CSV header + valid example row. Import: multipart AND raw text/csv body both work; mixed file (1 good, 1 bad quantity) -> 200 {imported:1, skipped:1, total:2, errors:[{line:3, reason:"quantity not an integer ('xyz')"}]} honest partial success; empty -> 400; non-UTF-8 -> 400; 10.8MB -> 413 (streamed cap exercised live).

GET /metrics unauthenticated -> 200 text/plain; version=0.0.4 with HELP/TYPE lines, cadverify_http_requests_total counters, duration histograms, jobs/batches gauges and cadverify_async_worker_up. Note: with uvicorn --workers 4 each worker exposes its own in-process registry, so a single scrape shows one worker's counters (repeated scrapes show all series); not part of the story's expected contract. METRICS_ENABLED=0 and missing-prometheus-client paths not exercisable without env changes (notes-only).

After many ULID-addressed requests, 4 aggregated scrapes contain ZERO raw ULIDs (regex 01[ULID]{24} = 0 matches); batch/reconstruct routes appear only as templates (/api/v1/batch/{batch_id}, .../cancel, .../items, .../results/csv, /api/v1/reconstructions/{job_id}/mesh.stl); unmatched requests collapse to __unmatched__; cost_decisions_total clamped (outcome=ok observed, fixed set); jobs/batches status gauges bucketed with explicit 'other' overflow bucket.
